mapper.insert: insert into ai_trace_span (run_id, session_id, parent_span_id, span_type, agent_id, sub_agent_id, model_id, model_name, tool_name, tool_call_id, call_seq, depth, status, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, cache_hit_tokens, cache_miss_tokens, usage_source, duration_ms, started_at, finished_at, create_time) values (#{runId}, #{sessionId}, #{parentSpanId}, #{spanType}, #{agentId}, #{subAgentId}, #{modelId}, #{modelName}, #{toolName}, #{toolCallId}, #{callSeq}, #{depth}, #{status}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{cacheHitTokens}, #{cacheMissTokens}, #{usageSource}, #{durationMs}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update ai_trace_span set status = #{status}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, prompt_tokens = #{promptTokens}, completion_tokens = #{completionTokens}, total_tokens = #{totalTokens}, cache_hit_tokens = #{cacheHitTokens}, cache_miss_tokens = #{cacheMissTokens}, usage_source = #{usageSource} where span_id = #{spanId}
mapper.select: select * from ai_trace_span where run_id = #{runId} order by started_at asc, span_id asc
select * from ai_trace_span where session_id = #{sessionId} and span_type = 'turn' order by started_at desc limit #{limit}

select run_id as runId, max(started_at) as startedAt, max(finished_at) as finishedAt, max(case when span_type = 'turn' then status end) as status, sum(case when span_type = 'llm' then 1 else 0 end) as llmCount, sum(case when span_type = 'tool' then 1 else 0 end) as toolCount, sum(case when span_type = 'subagent' then 1 else 0 end) as subagentCount, sum(ifnull(total_tokens, 0)) as totalTokens, max(case when span_type = 'turn' then duration_ms end) as durationMs from ai_trace_span where session_id = #{sessionId} group by run_id order by max(started_at) desc limit #{limit}
